description.value: PDS export of ip_105073_psc_F_story (pulse 105073); see the _psps_dto_extended.json companion

sign_frame.value: PCS frame: Ip > 0; coil currents in the PCS sign, i.e. negated with respect to the PDS design values

circuit_current_unit.value: conductor current in A per circuit, not ampere-turns; cs1 = CS1U + CS1L in series

time_origin.value: xValues, t0s/t0f and watchdog_s in s relative to the start of their segment

design_time_origin.value: design times (pds_additional.design_start_s): plasma_initiation (designer time, s); PSC clock 0 = 115.817598 s

catalogue_id_0.value: id "0": the PDS mode value has no catalogue entry (no shape control, feed-forward Ip); name = the PDS value

catalogue_mapping.value: ip_control 1 = KCURR, 2 = Ip by the shape controller; vs_control 1-4 = Off, VS1, VS3, VS1+VS3; shape_control 1-4 = RZIp, Isoflux, Isoflux XP, Gaps (PCS mode settings, assumption)

refpoint.value: isoflux refpoint assumed to be the limiter contact point R(t), Z(t); the design has none, placeholder zeros written

placeholders.value: a waveform the design does not provide is written as the 2-point zero waveform (0, 0), (segment duration, 0) and a missing isoflux point list as one zero point point01, never as an empty array (the PSPS GUI rejects empty arrays); in the zero-length STOP segment the placeholder is (0, 0), (0, 0); each is listed in properties.unfilled

setpoints_and_modes.value: every segment carries exactly one Magnetics setpoint and every setpoint at least one mode (the PSPS GUI rejects an empty setpoints object and an empty modes list, verified 2026-11-13); a segment without MCLS mode gets the placeholder mode 'default' (whole-segment window, Ip window 0, catalogue id 0); exception and STOP segments inherit the modes of the last nominal segment (assumption)

lists.value: list nodes hold struct nodes only (the PSPS GUI rejects a list of string or array nodes, verified 2026-11-13, series 2 variants V02 and V06): extension paths as path structs, string lists as item or field structs, matrices as row structs; all elements of a list carry the same keys in the same order (verified 2026-11-13, series 8) and, for the PSPS parser (psps-dto 1.4.0, checked 2026-11-16), the same type including array lengths and member types, with at least one element; collections whose elements differ (waveforms and scalars without a slot) are structs keyed <segment>__<quantity> or <quantity>

keys.value: struct keys contain only letters, digits, '_' and '-' (the GUI rejects other characters; verified 2026-11-13)

mode_windows.value: ip0s/ip0f in A (|Ip|), t0s/t0f in s; transition_conditions = entry conditions of the mode (assumption)

segment_ids.value: uuid5 of '<name>/segment/<segment name>', identical on every rerun; the PSPS may replace them

overlay_of.value: "" = the nominal segment active when the event fires

exception_duration.value: duration of an exception or STOP segment = its watchdog, or ramp + hold of its reference; 0 when the design gives neither
